title: Maximum Number of Nodes in a Tree of a Particular Height

blocks.content: Maximum Number of Nodes in a Tree of a Particular Height

blocks.alt: Maximum Number of Nodes at Given Height

blocks.content: In general, a tree with height h has, at most, 2h+1−12^{h+1} - 12h+1−1 nodes.
If we look at the figure above,

items: A binary tree of height 0 has only 1 (20+1−12^{0+1} - 120+1−1) node (the root node).
A binary tree of height 1 has, at most, 3 (21+1−12^{1+1} - 121+1−1) nodes.
A binary tree of height 2 has a maximum of 7 (22+1−12^{2+1} - 122+1−1) nodes and so on.
